title: Reduce route cells to titles and move explanatory copy outside
objective: Remove the decorative DNA hub, make route cells distinct title-only anchors, and move category, project, and section explanatory copy beside their corresponding cells.
acceptance_checks: the DNA hub and its decorative links are absent
Automation and Datenanalyse cells contain titles only; their descriptions are outside
project cells contain only their titles and preserve exactly one real primary link
project tags and lower CTA labels are absent
Digitale DNA and Ausgewählte Arbeiten are route cells with their introductory text beside them
route cells have visibly varied organic silhouettes
keyboard focus remains visible and motionless

result.summary: The decorative DNA hub, cell field, and its links are removed. Category, project, and two section-heading route cells now contain titles only; companion descriptions sit beside the relevant cell. Project tags and lower CTA labels are removed while one real title link per project remains.
checks: zero-consumer scan for removed DNA hub, project tags, and CTA labels

reviews.orchestrator_semantics_accessibility_rev: pass: all category cells remain anchors; each project retains exactly one real title link and whole-card enhancement remains progressive; focus does not move the cells.
reviews.orchestrator_visual_integration_review: pass: the competing DNA hub is absent, node silhouettes are varied, and titles in cells with adjacent copy create the requested hierarchy along the route.
